property_summary: After CashOut, the caller must not end up with a non-zero balance when they initially had exactly the amount cashed out, because the reference zeroes the balance before the external call so a re-entrant callee cannot double-spend; the buggy version writes state after the call, allowing a single re-entrant callback to withdraw against the still-unmodified balance.
change_summary: Move the balance update to after the external call, changing when state is written relative to the callee/re-entrant observation.
